description: This file implements the RDKWindowManager functionality, including display creation, key intercepts, input event management, and inactivity reporting, for the RDK platform. It contains class definitions, methods, and logic to manage window displays and input controls within the plugin framework.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing window and input management for RDK platform, including display creation, input interception, and inactivity reporting.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service, sets up event listeners, and starts the main thread loop.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops threads, and unregisters listeners.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event to registered listeners.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display window based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: GetClients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current clients.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Adds a key intercept for a client.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Adds multiple key intercepts.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept for a client.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a key event listener for a client.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes a key event listener for a client.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Simulates multiple key events for a client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity timeout interval.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets the inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat functionality.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether key inputs are ignored.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat settings.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Internal method to create display after client existence check.

classes.name: RdkWindowManagerListener
classes.description: Listener class for window manager events, such as user inactivity.

classes.name: CreateDisplayRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to create a display, including synchronization primitives.

methods.name: getKeyFlag
methods.description: Converts a modifier string to its corresponding key flag.

methods.name: lockRdkWindowManagerMutex
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the mutex lock with a timeout fallback.

methods.name: isClientExists
methods.description: Checks if a client already has a display or is registered.

methods.name: toLower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase.
